animals: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood
Sea otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart
Flamingos are born grey and turn pink from pigments in their food
Koala fingerprints are so similar to human ones they could confuse investigators
Polar bears have black skin, and their fur is see-through, not white
Starfish have no brain and no blood
Giraffes have 7 neck vertebrae, the same as humans
A shrimp's heart is in its head (cephalothorax)
Sharks (~450 million years) are older than trees (~385 million years)
space: A day on Venus is longer than its year
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth
Footprints on the Moon can last millions of years
About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun
A teaspoon of neutron star material would weigh about a billion tons
A year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years
Olympus Mons on Mars is about 2.5 times taller than Everest (~22 km)
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is wider than Earth
The Sun holds about 99.8% of the solar system's mass
Saturn is less dense than water
history: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire
The shortest war in history (Anglo-Zanzibar War, 1896) lasted under 45 minutes
Woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid was built
Napoleon wasn't short: about 5'7" (170 cm), average for his time
The Hundred Years' War lasted 116 years (1337-1453)
Vikings never wore horned helmets; that image came from 1800s art and opera costumes
Abraham Lincoln is in the National Wrestling Hall of Fame (inducted 1992)
Nintendo was founded in 1889 as a playing-card company
The fax machine (patented 1843) is older than the telephone (1876)
The Eiffel Tower was meant to be temporary (20-year permit)
The Statue of Liberty was originally copper-brown, not green
Einstein was offered the presidency of Israel in 1952
The US bought Alaska for about 2 cents an acre ($7.2M, 1867)
France used the guillotine until 1977, the year Star Wars came out
human_body: You're about 1 cm taller in the morning
Babies are born with about 300 bones; adults have 206
Your stomach lining renews itself every few days
You can't tickle yourself because your brain predicts the touch
Your heart beats about 100,000 times a day
Your brain uses about 20% of your body's energy but is only about 2% of your body weight
Tooth enamel is the hardest substance in the body
Your left lung is smaller than your right, to make room for the heart
The smallest bone (stapes) is in your ear, about 3 mm
Your blood vessels (~60,000 miles) could circle Earth twice
Babies don't have bony kneecaps; they start as cartilage
food: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't
Apples float because they're about 25% air
Carrots were originally purple or yellow; orange ones became popular in the 1600s
A pineapple plant takes about 2 years to grow one fruit
Vanilla comes from the seed pods of an orchid
Cashews grow outside their fruit, hanging below the cashew apple
Pistachios can spontaneously combust in large piles
Ketchup was sold as medicine (tomato pills) in the 1830s
White chocolate contains no cocoa solids, only cocoa butter
The Aztecs used cacao beans as money
Each strawberry 'seed' (achene) is its own fruit
The potato was the first food grown in space (Columbia, 1995)
